description: AUTHORITATIVE for "is this Czech company a reliable VAT payer" — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for the standard pre-invoice check in Czech B2B ("is CZ27082440 an unreliable VAT payer (nespolehlivý plátce DPH)", "which bank accounts has this supplier published for VAT"). Checks the Czech Financial Administration's unreliable VAT payer register for one DIČ (VAT number, with or without the CZ prefix) or IČO (8-digit company id). Returns an explicit status: "unreliable" (flagged, with the date the flag was published), "reliable" (a registered VAT payer NOT flagged), or "not_a_vat_payer" (the id is not in the VAT payer register at all). "not_a_vat_payer" is NOT a clean bill of health, it means there is no VAT registration to be reliable about. A malformed id is refused with an error rather than reported as not found. For companies it also returns the published bank accounts (an invoice paid to an unpublished account can leave the buyer liable for the VAT), the tax office code, and the register's answer date. Individuals (sole traders identified by a personal-number DIČ) get the status only: name, address and accounts are withheld.

id.description: Czech DIČ (VAT number) or IČO (company id). "CZ27082440", "27082440" and spaced forms all work, e.g. "27082440" (Alza.cz a.s.). An 8-digit value is also looked up in ARES so a sole trader's IČO resolves to its real DIČ.

name: ares_vat_reliability
